payload.title: File:Duonychus Size Comparison.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the holotype specimen (MPC-D 100/85) of Duonychus tsogtbaatari with an adult human male (~1.8 m) for reference.

References

  • "Didactyl therizinosaur with a preserved keratinous claw from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia"
  • "Two-fingered dinosaur used its enormous claws to eat leaves"
  • "Cranial anatomy of Erlikosaurus andrewsi (Dinosauria, Therizinosauria): new insights based on digital reconstruction"
  • "Dinosaurs from the Cretaceous of South China"
  • "A large therizinosauroid (Dinosauria: Theropoda) from the Early Cretaceous of Northwestern China"
  • "A new specimen of Suzhousaurus megatherioides (Dinosauria: Therizinosauroidea) from the Early Cretaceous of northwestern China"
  • "Hindlimb locomotor biomechanics of the derived therizinosaur Nothronychus: Functional changes in the line to birds and convergence with large-bodied neornitheans"
